canonical_title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Financial Services
treatment: Repeat only for major availability, pricing, data-provider, model, compliance-control, or adoption changes.
known_facts: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services for investment banking and equity research workflows.
Morgan Stanley and Evercore served as design partners.
The product uses GPT-6 Astra and integrates financial data from providers including LSEG, PitchBook and Daloopa.
It includes enterprise controls such as role-based access, encryption, and audit-log export workflows.
